name: av_stock_daily
description:
Daily OHLCV price history for one stock from Alpha Vantage (TIME_SERIES_DAILY, not split or dividend adjusted).
Returns: {"Meta Data", "Time Series (Daily)"} where each YYYY-MM-DD key holds open, high, low, close, volume. Alpha Vantage's JSON comes back unchanged, including its "Error Message" or "Information" notes; a network failure gives {"error": ...}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker); outputsize (compact = latest 100 days, full = 20+ years; default compact).
Coarser bars: av_stock_weekly, av_stock_monthly; intraday: av_stock_intraday. Other sources: yf_stock_history, openbb_equity_price.
Key: ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY (alpha_vantage.api.key); when unset the 'demo' key is sent, which only serves Alpha Vantage's documentation examples. Free tier: 25 requests/day.
Example: {"symbol": "IBM", "outputsize": "compact"}

outputsize.description: compact = latest 100 days, full = the whole history
